mapper.insert: INSERT INTO med_staff (mem_id, role, license_number, status, med_dept_id, spot_id) VALUES (#{memId}, #{role}, #{licenseNumber}, #{status}, #{medDeptId}, #{spotId})

INSERT INTO reservation ( mem_id, med_dept_id, doctor_id, reservation_date, reservation_time, reservation_type, visit_type, reservation_status, reservation_memo, reservation_made_time ) VALUES ( #{memId}, #{medDeptId}, #{doctorId}, #{reservationDate}, #{reservationTime}, #{reservationType}, #{visitType}, #{reservationStatus}, #{reservationMemo}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT med_dept_id, dept_name, dept_location, dept_phone_number FROM med_dept ORDER BY dept_name ASC
SELECT s.med_staff_id AS staff_id, s.role, m.name AS staff_name FROM med_staff s JOIN mem m ON s.mem_id = m.mem_id WHERE s.med_dept_id = #{medDeptId} AND s.role = 'DOCTOR' AND s.status = '재직'

SELECT r.reservation_id, r.reservation_date, r.reservation_time, r.reservation_status, d.dept_name, m.name AS doctor_name FROM reservation r JOIN med_dept d ON r.med_dept_id = d.med_dept_id JOIN med_staff s ON r.doctor_id = s.med_staff_id JOIN mem m ON s.mem_id = m.mem_id WHERE r.mem_id = #{memId} ORDER BY r.reservation_date DESC, r.reservation_time DESC

SELECT r.reservation_id, r.reservation_date, r.reservation_time, r.visit_type, r.reservation_memo, r.reservation_status, m.name AS patient_name, m.phone_number AS patient_phone FROM reservation r JOIN mem m ON r.mem_id = m.mem_id WHERE r.doctor_id = #{doctorId} ORDER BY r.reservation_date ASC, r.reservation_time ASC
